questions.question: Which correctly describes the return values of fork() in a Unix-like OS?

questions.question: Which statement about mutual exclusion is false?
options: No two processes can execute in their critical sections at the same time
Multiple processes can safely access a shared critical resource at the same time without synchronization
Processes outside the critical section should not interfere with those inside
Mutual exclusion helps prevent race conditions
Only one process can access a critical resource at a time
questions.explanation: Mutual exclusion means only one process at a time; simultaneous unsynchronised access is the FALSE statement (PYQ 2023).

questions.question:
Using the Banker's algorithm, how many safe sequences are possible?
Process  Alloc(R1 R2 R3)  Max(R1 R2 R3)
P1       0 1 0            7 5 3
P2       2 0 0            3 2 2
P3       3 0 2            9 0 2
P4       2 1 1            2 2 2
Available = 3 2 1
questions.explanation: Need = Max − Alloc: P1 743, P2 122, P3 600, P4 011. P4 → avail 532, P2 → 732, P3 → 10 3 4, then P1 needs 4 of R2 but only 3 exist → stuck. Unsafe → 0 (PYQ 2022). Shortcut: P1's Max R2 (5) exceeds total R2 (4).
